title: Line to Line Centerline Annotation
description: Defines a centerline between two given edges. The edges may be linear-apparent or circular

edge1.description: First definition edge for the dimension (linear or linear-apparent)

edge2.description: Second definition edge for the dimension

rightExtensionLength.description: Right extension length of centerline with respect to edge1

leftExtensionLength.description: Left extension length of centerline with respect to edge1
